data.title: Upcoming Events
data.subtitle: Join us for our next event! This is a great opportunity to connect with others and enhance your knowledge and skills.

image.imageName: Picture of DSMLC's power bi workshop

data.text: Expand your knowledge, connect with industry professionals, and engage with peers who share your passion for data science and machine learning. From skill-building workshops to networking nights and our flagship Final Competition, each event is designed to inspire growth and foster meaningful connections. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to learn, collaborate, and take your career to the next level!
